verdict.rationale: Pulley is a SaaS equity-management platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack contains no mention of any official SDK, API client library, or developer API. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, and llms.txt covers only the help center, which is not an SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
